name: helm
description: Helm charts deployed to the personal Kubernetes cluster

scripts.helm:deps: helm dependency update ./metrics-server && helm dependency update ./external-dns && helm dependency update ./cloudnative-pg
scripts.helm:template: helm template metrics-server ./metrics-server > /dev/null && helm template external-dns ./external-dns > /dev/null && helm template cloudnative-pg ./cloudnative-pg > /dev/null
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run helm:lint
scripts.fix:all: bun run lint:fix && bun run helm:lint
